about: DW2 models the game uses, built on the player's machine from their own Digimon World 2 disc by tools/dw2/dw2_addon.py. Name = the converter's output stem (<stem>.gltf). tests/dw2-addon.test.js checks every web/mount.js model is listed.

models.328QUNI: Unimon field model: the mount (web/mount.js MOUNTS unimon.model)
models.033UNIM: Unimon battle model: the hurt quest character (web/mount.js MOUNTS unimon.actor.hurt.model)
